title: Watch out of paint
text:
Watch out of paint. Most of the fronds stand out to 5-7.5 inches tall. The fronds themselves show a green ombre effect. The plant itself is very soft. My only complaint is with the bases. I was gently rubbing the bases and the black was coming off both off them (one a little more so than the other). Granted, not much of the paint was removed but I was still hesitant about putting the plant in my tank. I ended up tearing the ferns from their bases and created my own fish safe bases out of silicon. Overall all the plant does look nice just be prepared to either throw out the plant or make your own bases.

Edit on 8/10/17
The plants ended up tearing the fins. I wouldn't recommend this for betta tanks for I might for any other species.
